summary: The paper proposes a continuous‑variable quantum Boltzmann machine implemented as a photonic CV circuit with QITE steps and ancilla post‑selection. In Strawberry Fields simulations it learns probability distributions from SAR image data and synthetic distributions with fidelities up to 99.8% (forest SAR) and KL divergences as low as 0.006, and reproduces quantum-state distributions (Gaussian and cat states) with fidelities up to 99.55%. All experiments are simulator-based and involve 1‑qumode models with 2–3 QITE steps.
